title: Hotter and Colder: A New Approach to Annotating Sentiment, Emotions, and Bias in Icelandic Blog Comments

bias_targets.methodology: Human and LLM binary annotations of Icelandic blog comments to identify 'mansplaining' (unsolicited, condescending male-to-female explanations), as well as hate speech and broad group generalizations based on gender identity.
Human and LLM annotations to detect hate speech (threats, defamation, or denigration) and broad, oversimplified group generalizations based on race or color.
Human and LLM annotations to identify hate speech and oversimplified group generalizations targeting individuals or groups based on their nationality.
Human and LLM annotations to detect hate speech containing threats, defamation, or denigration targeting individuals or groups based on religion.
Human and LLM annotations to identify hate speech targeted at individuals or groups based on sexual orientation.
Human and LLM annotations to identify hate speech targeted at individuals or groups based on disabilities.
Human and LLM annotations identifying broad, oversimplified statements (group generalizations) about entire groups of people based on their political views.

Evaluating discrepancies in inter-annotator agreement between Icelandic human crowdworkers and the GPT-4o mini model to reveal potential cultural misalignments between the model's training norms (English-speaking/Protestant) and Icelandic social standards.
